title: Show whether rubric optimizer ran and changed active rubric

comments.author: home
comments.text: Replaced rubric event counts with recorded LLM-call and active rubric change status. Cell selection opens the optimizer exchange and actual before/after rubric. Tests cover rejected proposals, changed active rubric, running requests, and missing snapshots. Python: 525 passed. Browser verified cycle 6 shows Ran · Changed, full optimizer request and before/after rubric. No live model calls.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Follow-up: rubric row is now text-free full-cycle blocks. Green means recorded acceptance/activation; grey means a call without acceptance; no call has no block. Tooltip and click details preserve ran/changed status and model exchange. Verified green empty-content cell in browser; regression specs distinguish acceptance from merely proposing a change.
